_meta.purpose: Illustrative shape of cross-platform observations normalized into one stream and resolved to a durable subject.
_meta.warning: Every handle, name, identifier, timestamp, and piece of content below is invented. No real account, person, organization, or post is represented. This file does not execute and calls nothing.
_meta.design_status: The subject graph and platform adapters described here are DESIGN, not built. See docs/roadmap.md — H2.
_meta.schema_note: Field names illustrate concepts from docs/architecture.md §6. They are not the production contract and are not an integration target.

subject._note: The durable unit. Platform accounts are projections OF this subject, not the identity itself. Memory, reputation, and policy attach here, so they survive a platform being added, lost, or replaced.
subject._resolution_note: verified_link records HOW a projection was tied to the subject. 'unresolved' is a first-class value: an unproven link is never silently promoted to a proven one.

normalized_events._note: The author resolves to no known subject. Null is correct and is not backfilled with a guess.

normalized_events._note: Unresolved and retained as unresolved. An unattributed observation is more useful than a wrongly-attributed one.

correlated_view._note: The point of the layer: one timeline per subject, not one inbox per network.

open_thread.why_flagged: Substantive technical disagreement from a resolved subject — worth a reply.
open_thread._gate: Any reply is an irreversible external action. It stops at an approval gate regardless of standing permission. See docs/security-boundaries.md — I5.

adapter_contract_sketch._note: Conceptual only. The real port is not published, and no adapter implementation appears in this repository.
adapter_contract_sketch._constraint_note: Values are illustrative placeholders, not a claim about any platform's current limits.
adapter_contract_sketch.sequencing_rule: Read-only adapters ship before write adapters. A wrong read produces a bad report; a wrong write produces a public post from an account you own.

retirement._note: A withdrawn platform's adapter is retained as a tombstone that fails with a typed error and migration guidance, rather than deleted — which would turn every stored reference into an opaque crash.

_absent_by_design: real platform API endpoints, request shapes, or response bodies
